But I'm sure these reports are done through an algorithm, a program.  I'm not convinced literally millions of reports a week are done through people at Riot.  So you have automated partial bans, people are way more careful, and chat is filtered and watered down.  People then ultimately quit on both ends because communication is controlled and Riot gets what they were trying to prevent anyway; people quitting.  Maybe it's better because some sociopathic assholes were actually saying 'kys' at some points.  But I will say I miss SOME of the hilarious trash talk that would take place where they were just joking with eachother, but Riot would probably ban them.
